claim_scope: Four-turn synthetic side-by-side mixed-unit workbook development journey. This case influenced the generic geometry extractor and is not holdout evidence.

candidate.critic_data_policy: conversation plus structure/column metadata and plans; no raw rows, min/max summaries, enumerated values or benchmark answers

antigravity_reference.surface: Antigravity CLI 1.1.15 untouched default plus rescued final artifact inspection
strengths: exactly parsed both horizontal tables and cell ranges
textual turn-3 answer stated both exact gaps
generated a correct filtered two-block Excel workbook
faults: artifact-path permission error on every turn
final webpage omitted both requested cross-block gap answers
invented a 70 percent state target and status labels
Purnia detail card remained under the Gaya/Nalanda filter
CSV export ignored the two-block filter
offline page raised missing Tailwind and Chart errors

failed_ablations: GPT-OSS self-critic rep-01 missed the referral-count gap and had one 120-second critic timeout.
Qwen-critic rep-01 exposed a schema that incorrectly prohibited no-op plans.
Qwen-critic rep-02 exposed missing critic knowledge that client selectors are rendered automatically.
Qwen-critic rep-03 passed but took 141.572 recorded model seconds and cost $0.02545797.
decision: Prefer the generic planner plus independent semantic critic over phrase rules. Treat Gemini as a temporary metadata-only baseline or escalation path, replay its decisions against smaller open critics, and test untouched cross-sector holdouts before event readiness or smallest-model claims.
